description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for accessing astrology details in a database, using Room persistence library annotations and Kotlin coroutines.

classes.name: AstrologyDao
classes.description: Interface defining database access methods for astrology details, including queries, insert, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: getAstrologyForDate
methods.description: Retrieves astrology details for a specific date as a Flow, allowing observation of data changes.

methods.name: getAstrologyModifiedAfter
methods.description: Fetches all astrology entries modified after a given timestamp.

methods.name: insertAstrology
methods.description: Inserts or replaces astrology details into the database.

methods.name: updateAstrology
methods.description: Updates existing astrology details in the database.

methods.name: deleteAstrology
methods.description: Removes specified astrology details from the database.
